watch.en: First-half FY2026 revenue included ¥194.8 billion from Lenvima and ¥61.5 billion from Leqembi.

watch.en: First-half R&D spending was ¥88.1 billion; investment prioritized E2814 and E2086.
watch.zh: 上半年研发支出为881亿日元;投资优先投向E2814和E2086。

watch.en: Lenvima is jointly developed with Merck and Leqembi with Biogen.
watch.zh: Lenvima与Merck联合开发,Leqembi与Biogen联合开发。

watch.en: The first-line RCC pembrolizumab/belzutifan/lenvatinib triplet failed its dual primary endpoints at interim analysis.
watch.zh: 一线RCC pembrolizumab/belzutifan/lenvatinib三药联合在中期分析时未达到双重主要终点。

gaps: Eisai's main website and IR entry returned 403. The company pipeline PDF that loaded is dated August 5, 2025, older than June 2026; it was superseded for item status by the complete November 10, 2026 pipeline in the company's reference data, accessed through FinancialFilings because the current primary-hosted materials were not reachable.

Etalanetug's phase 3 denotes a combined Phase II/III Tau NexGen trial, not a separate Phase III-only study. MORAb-202 Phase I/II and E7386 Phase Ib/II are represented as phase 2; subphases are compressed to the allowed schema.
No company-reported totals by phase were verified; counts is null.

Approved lecanemab, lemborexant, lenvatinib, taletrectinib and tasurgratinib were excluded: the reviewed pending geographic/formulation filings do not establish a major new indication filing. Lecanemab's asymptomatic-AD expansion remains Phase 3, not filed.

E2511 small molecule modality is explicit in the company March 2024 poster, older than June 2026; current phase remains Phase 1b in the November reference data. No company-stated future milestone dates were verified for the eight selected programs.
